tenant-изоляцию молча (`RAG:✅` perplexity Q19).

sections.title: Validation
sections.text: `composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy lint:check && composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy analyse && composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy test` и корневой `composer test:pg`. Семь FQCN §6.4 равны `config('tenancy.bootstrapper_order')` и `config('tenancy.bootstrappers')`. `rg -n '->(singleton|scoped|bind|bindIf)\(' packages/tenancy/src/TenancyServiceProvider.php` пуст. Real tenancy registrars pass P3 R4 and the D101 closed CoreZone map without a Support wildcard. `bash scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh` зелёный.
